design: The first page-scoped pilot identified overlong copied modifiers in changed spans. Second development hypothesis: reject transported answers whose word length changes by more than a factor of 1.5 in either direction. Retain the prior name, phrase and evidence alignment rules. The guard gets no reference answers.
policies: Qwen: same prefix replay, guarded surface repair with unique-edit fallback, guarded surface repair with attention-trace fallback. RoBERTa-SQuAD2: read both editions independently, earlier answer then surface repair or reread with and without the guard. No cache transfer claim for output-string repair. Compare the fastest adequate CPU reader as well as native Qwen.
dev_gate: Select a guarded policy within each model only if it meets both current exact-match count and mean token F1 of its always-reread comparator and uses at least 20% fewer model positions and 20% less warm measured lifecycle time. Prefer text-only policy when score ties. Incremental native contribution additionally requires 2 extra exact answers or a >=10% time gain at matched quality against guard-only text. Measure each policy online, including first answer and any fallback. Report scores of all alternatives.
confirmation: If a within-model guard passes in development, evaluate the frozen guard and relevant cheap alternative on a separate 96-page HoH page-subscription cohort. Order by SHA256 of 'hoh-refresh-test-20261118/' plus page ID; exclude all 352 prior HoH development, transfer and calibration pages and all previously excluded DynaQuest titles. Use same selection within a page. On Qwen switch to pinned Qwen3.5-9B 4-bit; retain exact prefix replay, ungated surface repair, native if competitive, and the span-reader control. A positive transfer efficiency result requires at least 20% lower total positions and elapsed time with no decrease in either current exact count or F1 relative to the named comparator. Distinguish such conditional evidence from dominance over independent CPU readers or improvements in cold open QA.
budget: 32 dev and conditionally 96 disjoint test pages, 32 answer tokens and 30 minutes per phase, one repair, local CPU and MLX, no paid credits.
